newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Scotts sees S$6 mln profit from property.
newsitem.headline: Scotts sees S$6 mln profit from property.

text.p: Retail and property group Scotts Holdings Ltd said on Monday it expected a net profit of Singapore S$6.0 million when its first Singapore residential property project, Villa Begonia, was completely sold.

It had sold 12 units since its launch in October this year and was negotiating several more sales, said Jessie Goh, director of Scott's finance division, in answer to shareholder queries at its annual general meeting.
Villa Begonia comprises three bungalows, 22 semi-detached and 19 terrace houses and is located off Yio Chu Kang, in northern Singapore.
Scotts also obtained shareholder approval to diversify into property development at an extraordinary meeting on Monday.
Officials said the Stock Exchange of Singapore had asked the company to seek shareholder approval to diversify into property development although it had already entered into the business.
Chuen Fah Alain Ahkong, who was reppointed as a director at the AGM, said Scotts also had some land in Bangalore, India which the company had to consider whether to develop.
